propositions: The reconciler's backend-neutral core reached the Jira vendor mapper entrypoint directly instead of going through the Backend port.
Route the vendor mapper entrypoint access in outbound_differ, inbound_differ, and apply_inbound through the Backend port via dependency injection.
run_differs is the production injection point that resolves the configured backend once and threads backend.outbound/backend.inbound into both differ phases, defaulting to None via select_backend.
Relocate outbound_links._RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK into adapters/jira/jira_fields.py so the Jira link map is single-sourced.

Non-mapping vendor helpers (_diff_fields, _extract_jira_field, _assignee_matches, inbound value maps) and reconcile_check's lazy _load_sibling stay directly imported as a documented residual for a separate follow-up.
AST neutrality tests must verify the core has no module-level vendor mapper imports and that injected mappers are actually exercised.
